# cdnpro_secret (Resource)

A CDN Pro secret, referenced from Edge Logic as `$SECRET(name)` or from an origin's `aws_s3.secret_key`. The value is write-only: the API only ever returns a masked form, so the provider stores a hash and patches the secret in place when the configured value changes. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Properties reference secrets by name as plain text, so add `depends_on` on the property.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cdnpro_secret" "origin_auth" {
  name        = "origin-auth-token"
  description = "Shared secret for the origin authentication header"
  secret      = var.origin_auth_secret # write-only, never stored in state
}

# Edge Logic references the secret by name as plain text ($SECRET(origin-auth-token)),
# which Terraform cannot see, so declare the dependency explicitly.
resource "cdnpro_property" "main" {
  # ...
  depends_on = [cdnpro_secret.origin_auth]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `name` (String) Secret name, unique within the account. This is what Edge Logic references.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret value (printable ASCII, 8 to 3599 characters). Never read back into state.

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_update_time` (String) Becomes unknown in a plan whenever the configured `secret` differs from the stored hash.
- `usage_in_production` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage_in_production))
- `usage_in_staging` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage_in_staging))

<a id="nestedatt--usage_in_production"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage_in_production`

Read-Only:

- `property_id` (String)

### Nested Schema for `usage_in_staging`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by secret ID. The value is write-only; the first plan after import shows no diff for it.
terraform import cdnpro_secret.origin_auth k3j9d8s7f6g5h4j3
```
